crosscut_cases.description: Anonymous same-Android-app localhost client denied all sensitive tools, even if Origin/Host resembles trusted client
Host client identity must be mutually proved; ADB serial and USB forwarding alone confer no authorization
Pairing proof binds Native installation ID, Host key, OS boot epoch, exact user-selected target
Challenge nonce replay, expired timestamp, forged signer, wrong audience and clock rollback fail closed
Native Keystore signing private keys never exported or persisted in plaintext
Device and Host trust store deletion invalidates all sessions and must not auto-accept new key
Unexpected MCP Origin/Host/Forwarded headers and duplicate security headers denied
MCP tools/list and tools/call have consistent permission filtering, including race with revoke
Two real Host processes compete for same Native write, exactly one fixture effect
Host and Native own UI pipelines share one real lease and cannot write concurrently
Action digest, request ID, nonce, fence and owner are checked immediately before Android operation
Operation timeout after possible side effect reports UNCERTAIN and requires reconciliation
Native process death between intent acceptance and effect preserves write-ahead journal semantics
Host process death between commit and ACK does not silently replay a non-idempotent action
User Stop/disable/unpair immediately fences all in-flight actions and sessions
OS reboot invalidates ephemeral consent/session state and does not cause autostart
MediaProjection positive and denied OS dialog results tested independently of mock status
Android 14+ projection one-session consent/token re-use rejected by actual API
Accessibility enabled through Settings UI with intended declared capability; disabling revokes promptly
SAF selected provider READ vs WRITE grant, cancellation and process death observed
PackageInstaller pending user action, approve/deny/cleanup observed with pinned APK
Android foreground and background Activity launch policies enforced by OS not synthetic flags
Other user/secure-window/password node remains protected in scope-limited UI operations
Dangerous policy, device admin or OEM-maintenance grants never inferred from user prompt
Four QEMU API30/33/34/36 devices identity-pinned and exclusively leased before mutable test
Evidence includes exact Git commit/tree, signed APK hash, fixture hash and real API-level OS oracle
Original 228 test case IDs mapped to exact executed test IDs and evidence, with no assumed pass
Cross-runtime Host shared contract compatibility tested by both Host and Native consumers
Real native MCP Java/Kotlin SDK wire contract Tools/list/Call verified before and after grants
Non-E2E or not-run test cannot set PRODUCT_DONE; dynamic missing work creates traced blocker
Unattended session interruption must preserve durable task state; no false background-completion claim
Final product sign-off compares requested original feature list, runtime registry, ledger and evidence; zero silent exclusions

required_old_to_new_traceability: Every T-Nxx-01..06 must map to executable test(s), evidence and test level; missing mapping creates a new mandatory gap before release

completion_logic.required_native_feature_done: Positive real Native MCP to Android API to independently observed effect plus all required negatives/recovery on each applicable tested SDK, production policy/approval gates, and zero unresolved required gaps
completion_logic.release_done: No unresolved required feature, E2E, security, consent, cross-runtime, deployment and acceptance gaps; only explicitly scoped Android platform exclusions allowed, with proven Host fallback when defined
completion_logic.external_block: Keep FEATURE_NOT_DONE, capture exact blocker and independently continue safe work, never silently downgrade user product scope
